capabilities: Sync notes, attachments, settings, themes and plugins end-to-end encrypted
Approve or remove per-device encryption keys and create a recovery key
Merge concurrent edits and keep both versions on conflicting line changes
Browse and restore file version history held on the server
Run a device in remote-only mode with locking and remote wipe
disambiguation: Not a file-transfer or backup tool; it requires a Sync server you host yourself and the plugin alone does nothing.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; the encryption key is kept in Obsidian's secret storage. Server needs ports 80 and 443 open and a shared secret from the server admin to create the first vault. Android and Windows are under-tested and testers are wanted. Beta releases are untested work in progress that may lose or corrupt data. The server also offers an admin page, Prometheus metrics and a Grafana dashboard.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync is a paid service and other sync options either store readable notes on a third-party server or leave plaintext copies on devices you don't control.

requires.name: Vault Syncryption server (Docker host with public IP and DNS)

summary: Self-hosted end-to-end encrypted sync plugin that syncs the whole vault, including settings and plugins, through a server you run.
